sol.menu.about.title: About Sol Client
sol.menu.about.stars: The stars: the HYG Database v4.1 by David Nash, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Sol's star file is an adaptation of it (cut to magnitude 6.5, fewer fields) and is shared under the same licence.
sol.menu.about.constellations: The constellations' lines, names and label places: d3-celestial by Olaf Frohn, under the BSD 3-Clause licence.
sol.menu.about.fonts: Geist and Geist Mono by Vercel, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
sol.menu.about.lab: The night sky (the Milky Way, the nebulae, the planets and wild worlds, the moon and the sky's events) is ported from Sol's own Night Sky lab.
sol.menu.about.moon_looks: Moon look files take the shape of Enhanced Celestials' lunar events, so packs can share them.
sol.menu.about.licences: The full licences are in the jar: assets/cosmeticsmod/sky/CREDITS.txt and assets/cosmeticsmod/font/geist-ofl.txt.
